lines: Senzaki, one of the most prominent criminal cities in the metropolitan area.
It was a city that had formerly been developed as Tokyo's dormitory city.
However, since the influx of war refugees, its center had become a slum,
and inhabitants of the Devildom and criminal organizations had flowed in as well. Now it had grown into a large downtown area filled with corruption.
Also, due to Senzaki's strategically important trading port,
intense conflicts were frequently erupting between the forces of darkness who wanted to use it as a base of operations.
I was infiltrating that dangerous city at that time.
And as for who my partner wasー
Yukikaze
Hey, can't you tell me already?
Me
Hmm? Tell you what?
Yukikaze
Come on! How many times do I have to ask you!? I'm talking about the mission details!
Me
Sorry, but I can't tell you that.
Yukikaze
Huh!? Hebiko and Shikanosuke aren't even here with us!
Me
You'll know the reason soon.
Yukikaze
Geez what's with that...
The dissatisfied Yukikaze began to pout.
Since we left Gosha Village, we had repeated similar conversations like a broken record.
I had my own reasons for not giving her specific details regarding the mission.
However, this didn't go well with the personality of Yukikaze, who loved being frank about everything.
Yukikaze
Ahaa!
Yukikaze
Aaah, I see, I see. So that's what this is about. Nooow I get it.
Yukikaze, who'd been grumbling the whole time, suddenly let out a strange exclamation.
Me
Get what?
Yukikaze came around to my front and looked up at me with a triumphant look in her eyes.
Yukikaze
You used this mission as a pretext to have a date with me, didn't you?
Me
Huhh!?
Yukikaze
You always move as a squad, but this time it's a two-man cell!
Yukikaze
I see. You wanted to be alone with meー
Me
Fat chance of that.
Yukikaze
Stop with that act already! I didn't know you were such a shy boy, Fuma. It's okay. You don't have to hide it.
Me
This time it's better with fewer people. You're reading too much into this.
Yukikaze
Well, if you want to have a date with me that badly, I don't mind it, you know.
Yukikaze
But keep this a secret from Uncle. He'll kill you if he finds out about it.
Yukikaze
Oh, and it's better to keep it secret from Clear too. And Hebiko, and Sakura. Is there anyone else?
Her face clearly showed she was teasing me, as she continued to prattle on her own while counting her fingers.
Me
I told you it's not that!
Yukikaze
It's okay! Hey, I wanna eat something!
While she pointed at a stand with one hand, Yukikaze suddenly yanked at mine with her other.
Me
Wha-!?
My heart skipped a beat for a moment as her soft hand touched mine. It made me feel as if I were actually on a date with her.
Me
H-Hey! Listen to me! We're going over there!
I pointed at the large building that I saw right in front of me.
Yukikaze
Oh in there? Is it any good?
Me
It's not a restaurant! It's a casino.
Yukikaze
A casino!? But I'm hungry.
Me
I beg you, just stay away from the food.
Yukikaze
What about if it was a date?
Me
Stay even further away.
Yukikaze
Geez. You're no fun.
Yukikaze let go of my hand as if tossing some trash to the wayside.
Me
Sheesh. We're gonna meet with the boss of Senzaki to get some information.
Yukikaze
The boss? Hmm. So you can meet those kind of people. You're pretty good at this, huh?
Me
Well, they are an old friend after all.
Yukikaze
Then, let's go meet that boss or whatever♪
I wasn't certain about what she was expecting, but she gave me a beaming smile.
An enormous casino spread throughout the basement of that building.
The place was crowded with men and women of all ages, from gentlemen dressed in luxurious suits and accompanied by beautiful women to gamblers aiming at striking it rich.
Bills and chips flew about, and I, who was always quite lacking in the money department, felt quite out of place.
On the other hand, the well-off Yukikaze looked completely unfazed.
Yukikaze
Is this old friend of yours really here?
Me
Yeah. Well, there are many different people in the Fuma Clan.
Yukikaze
Oh, so it's someone from your clan, huh?
Yukikaze, replying inattentively, was looking at the video game-type casino machine that had been quite popular recently.
Yukikaze
FPS, racing, fighting... They even have puzzle games. Wow～
Me
Just so you know, we're not here to play.
Yukikaze
I'm just looking. Woaahh～ I don't even know about these games♪
The top-notch gamer Y-kazeX-chan was itching to show her skills.
Just as I was thinking her gamer side was going to cause us trouble...
Hey, hey, who was it? Who let Gosha trash inside my territory?
Yukikaze
Wha-!?
Yukikaze's movements were swift.
Before I could even react to our predicament, Yukikaze had already pointed her guns at the person who'd picked a fight with us.
It was a showy blonde man with some lackeys in tow.
Yukikaze
Can I beat him up?
Hmm, you're also a gunman, huh?
The blond man grinned, and his followers also drew their guns in unison.
Woman
Don't you know? The use of guns is the biggest no-no in here.
Guard
Throw those away if you don't want to turn into Swiss cheese.
Yukikaze
Hey! Didn't you say he was your friend?
Me
He's supposed to be.
She was one to talk considering she had been the one to draw first.
It was par for the course for Yukikaze to speedrun us into peril.
